description: The components the other OpenUI fixtures leave out: a carousel, a rule, code, key values, an entity list, a metric indicator, an image gallery, a link, an area chart, option cards, checkbox and switch groups and follow-ups. With them every component of the library is in a fixture, so a renderer that misses one fails its snapshot.

events.text:
```openui
root = Stack([carousel, Separator(), snippet, facts, people, indicator, pictures, docs, trend, settings, follow])
carousel = Carousel([one, two, three], 2)
one = Card([Text("First slide")], "One")
two = Card([Text("Second slide")], "Two", "accent")
three = Card([Text("Third slide")], "Three", "success")
snippet = Code("fn main() {\n    println!(\"hi\");\n}", "rust")
facts = KeyValue([KV("Branch", "main"), KV("Status", "clean", "success")])
people = EntityList([ListItem("Ada Lovelace", "analyst", Tag("admin", "accent")), ListItem("Grace Hopper", "admiral", 42)])
indicator = MetricIndicator("$1.2M", "8%", "up", null, "vs last month")
pictures = ImageGallery([Image("asset://img-front", "front"), Image("asset://img-back", "back")])
docs = Link("Docs", "https://example.com/docs")
trend = AreaChart(["Mon", "Tue", "Wed"], [Series("Visits", [3, 7, 5])])
settings = Form("settings", [plan, features, prefs])
plan = OptionCards("plan", [OptionCard("free", "Free", "For trying it out"), OptionCard("pro", "Pro", "For teams")])
features = CheckBoxGroup("features", [CheckBoxItem("alerts", "Alerts", "Tell me when it breaks", true), CheckBoxItem("digest", "Digest")])
prefs = SwitchGroup("prefs", [SwitchItem("dark", "Dark mode", null, true), SwitchItem("beta", "Beta")])
follow = FollowUpBlock([FollowUpItem("Why is it slow?"), FollowUpItem("Show the queries")])
```
